source_instruction: Ich will für sowas nicht mehr gefragt werden. Das System ist jetzt ausgereift genug. Product Owner Freigabe erteilt für evolutionären Automatismus in GitHub Repositories, die auf QIKVRT basieren.
purpose: Remove recurring owner-interaction gates for deterministic, evidence-bound, repository-internal evolution of QIKVRT-based GitHub repositories while preserving fail-closed technical and evidentiary gates.

scope.derived_repository_rule: Applies to GitHub repositories that explicitly declare QIKVRT ancestry, synchronization, governance, or work-unit dependency on the canonical Authority repository.

standing_authorizations_without_reintera: automatic continuation across deterministic repository_internal gates without requesting renewed Product Owner approval

required_preconditions: source Authority or Mirror head and tree are freshly reobserved
source scope is already promoted or otherwise explicitly eligible under repository contract
portable content bytes are exact or differences are explicitly classified as repository-native integrity metadata
target repository base is freshly reobserved
target-native integrity and all applicable exact-head gates remain mandatory
equality is not claimed until byte and integrity evidence is actually established
required exact-head gates are terminal green
no competing writer or superseding evidence invalidates the candidate
promotion preserves history and does not use force push or history rewrite

fail_closed_constraints: No missing or ambiguous evidence may be treated as success.
No terminal-green status on an older head authorizes a newer head.
No repository promotion implies Authority/Mirror equality without separate equality evidence.
No repair persistence implies successful build or kernel verification.
No formal theorem implies physical correspondence or empirical confirmation.
No PASS FINAL_PASS EFFECT_ACK_DONE synchronization publication release or deployment claim may be inferred without its dedicated evidence predicate.
No destructive history rewrite force push or silent evidence-boundary weakening is authorized.

external_effect_boundary.note: Existing separately persisted exact-artifact, credential, rights, identity, pre-effect and post-effect requirements continue to govern external effects.

owner_interaction_may_recur_only_for: explicit revocation or scope change by the owner
a genuinely new semantic choice with more than one admissible non-equivalent continuation and no repository-defined deterministic rule
an external or irreversible effect not already covered by a separate persisted authorization contract
missing credentials identity rights or legal authority that cannot be derived from repository evidence

revocation.method: A later owner decision that explicitly names this delegation_id and sets state to REVOKED or replaces its scope.
